acceptanceCriteria: A test makes a mapped write to an audited store file after the lease-path audit and before the lock-held commit, and the lease write refuses or fully re-audits. Run it on Linux tmpfs and macOS APFS, or record why a platform is not covered.
If the path is shown to be safe, the evidence for that is recorded and the ticket is closed as not a defect.
body:
Reported 2026-10-05 by the V1-0645 lane (claude/v1-0645-writer-checkpoint at e9001205, parent 4ba43576). It is a suspected defect: the lease path was inspected but no reproduction has been run.

V1-0645 r2 (Codex P1) confirmed that inotify on Linux arm64 tmpfs, and kqueue on macOS APFS without msync, miss writes made through a memory mapping. The lane reproduced a mapped projection committing through Mutate when the content check was forced to pass. Its fix makes Mutate always take a fresh inventory, and reuse the merged audit only when every file the audit read matches by digest and size.

The lease path has not had the same fix. internal/tasks/store/lease_write.go:156 passes the audit's observation.Files into guardedLeaseInventory. Under the lock it appears to rely only on Check and the head digest (the lane cited lines 397 and 436), so a mapped write after the audit could go undetected.

Expected: a lease write refuses or re-audits when any audited file's content changed through a mapping. Actual (suspected): the reused digests are accepted.
title: store: lease writes may reuse audit digests that miss mapped (mmap) writes (suspected)
